detect_new_test_flakes: run the script to detect new test flakes from BigQuery and print results in human or csv format
create_github_issues_for_flakes: create GitHub issues for newly detected test flakes with optional interactive or automatic assignment
search_github_issues: search existing GitHub issues for a given test name to check for preexisting reports
query_bigquery_for_failures: query BigQuery using a SQL template to retrieve new test failures within calibration and reporting date ranges
build_kokoro_build_url: build a Kokoro CI URL from a job name and build ID for linking to test failure results
